newsitem.title: USA: Nimbus CD sees DVD demand gaining momentum.
newsitem.headline: Nimbus CD sees DVD demand gaining momentum.

text.p: Nimbus CD International Inc said on Wednesday it sees demand for digital video disc (DVD) products gaining momentum during its current fiscal year, which began April 1.
Nimbus said it will open a new plant in Luxembourg and add eight new DVD-compatible production lines at its existing facilities in Charlottesville, Va., and Provo, Utah.
The consumer electronics industry hopes DVD products will have the same or greater impact on the market as audio CDs and videocassette recorders did when they were introduced.
Nimbus President Lyndon Faulkner said in a statement that as DVD player manufacturers increase production and lower prices, demand for these products will take off.
Nimbus reported a fourth quarter net loss of $0.08 per share, after a charge for closing a facility. That compares with a profit of $0.12 per share for the same period the year before.
Nimbus makes compact discs and provides DVD, software and audio production services.
